assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
The symptoms are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended rhythm assessment
The paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded I48.0
The recurrent syncope is coded R55
The cardiac event monitoring study is CPT 93271
The paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and recurrent syncope require correlation with the underlying arrhythmias to establish the cause of the patient's collapse
